item.title: Heartland College hosts KidWind Challenge for students
item.description: Heartland Community College hosted the Kidwind Challenge, teaching students how to work in teams and create wind turbines to generate as much power as possible.

item.title: State Rep. Jehan Gordon-Booth visits Peoria school for Black History presentation
item.description: Democratic State Rep. Jehan Gordon-Booth visited Pleasant Valley Intermediate School to give a presentation on Black History, featuring drama, music, and speeches, and ended by giving out $25 gift cards to students who answered trivia questions.

item.title: Chicago double murder suspect arrested in Missouri, faces multiple charges
item.description: Muhammad Thomas, wanted for a double murder and multiple other crimes in Chicago, was arrested in St. Louis, Missouri and extradited back to Chicago to face charges.

item.title: Accidental fire causes $80,000 damage to Peoria home
item.description: A fire caused $80,000 in damage to a Peoria home under construction, with no injuries reported and the fire determined to be accidental.

item.title: More than 1,000 people take the plunge in Bloomington to support Special Olympics Illinois
item.description: Over 1,000 participants from across Central Illinois braved cold water to raise over $185,000 for the Special Olympics Illinois at the annual Law Enforcement Torch Run Polar Plunge.

item.title: Illinois leaders react to US, Israel attack on Iran
item.description: Illinois leaders have criticized President Trump's decision to launch an attack on Iran, citing the lack of justification, authorization from Congress, and potential consequences for American service members and regional stability.
